![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The color palette defined here (Primary: `#FF6B35`, Secondary: `#004E89`) significantly differs from the colors currently implemented in the global styles of `src/routes/+layout.svelte` (e.g., `--fuchsia: #e8006a`, `--gold: #c9a227`). If this document is intended to be the single source of truth for a rebranding, the implementation should be updated to match; otherwise, these tokens should reflect the existing visual identity.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The typography tokens specify `system-ui`, which contradicts the custom fonts (`Fraunces`, `Bricolage Grotesque`, `Barlow Condensed`) currently loaded and used in `src/routes/+layout.svelte`. To maintain consistency as a design system specification, these tokens should align with the intended production fonts.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `button-tertiary` component described in the Markdown section (line 120) is missing from the machine-readable YAML components specification. Adding it ensures that automated tooling can consume the full set of component tokens.

```markdown
components:
  button-primary:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.primary}"
    textColor: "#FFFFFF"
    rounded: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "12px 24px"
  button-secondary:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.secondary}"
    textColor: "#FFFFFF"
    rounded: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "12px 24px"
  button-tertiary:
    backgroundColor: "transparent"
    borderColor: "{colors.tertiary}"
    textColor: "{colors.tertiary}"
    rounded: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "12px 24px"
  card:
    backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF"
    rounded: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "24px"
    boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"
  input:
    backgroundColor: "#F9F9F9"
    borderColor: "#E0E0E0"
    rounded: "{rounded.md}"
    padding: "12px 16px"
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The layout section specifies a maximum width of `1200px`, but the existing implementation in `src/routes/+layout.svelte` (line 84) and `src/routes/+page.svelte` (line 1199) uses `1240px`. These should be synchronized to avoid layout discrepancies.

```suggestion
Content flows in a single-column layout on mobile with optional multi-column grids on desktop (max 1240px). The 8px spacing scale provides rhythm and breathing room. Generous padding (24px container padding) makes the interface feel open and non-cramped.
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

There is an internal inconsistency regarding input border radius. This line mentions `4px`, but the component specification (line 127) and the YAML token (line 73, referencing `rounded.md`) both specify `8px`.

```suggestion
All interactive elements use rounded corners (8px on inputs, 12px on buttons and cards) to feel approachable and less clinical. Consistency across shapes reinforces the playful aesthetic.
```

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add required top-level file header comment**

`AGENTS.md` under `/workspace/meechiescoloringbook` mandates that every file start with a top-level comment describing Purpose, Why, and Info flow, but this file begins immediately with front matter. This makes the new spec non-compliant with the repository’s documented governance checks and reduces traceability for future maintainers who rely on standardized file headers.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Define tertiary button in structured components spec**

The prose defines a **Tertiary Button**, but the machine-readable `components` block only contains `button-primary` and `button-secondary`. Any tooling or contributor that consumes the structured section as the source of truth will miss the tertiary variant, creating a concrete spec mismatch between the token definitions and the documented component set.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Align input corner radius across sections**

The Shapes section says inputs use `4px` corners, while both the tokenized `input` component and the Inputs section specify `8px`. This internal contradiction makes the spec non-deterministic for implementers and can produce inconsistent UI depending on which section a developer follows.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Encode input focus state in components token block**

The Inputs prose requires a primary-colored focus border, but the structured `components.input` definition has no focus-state fields. Consumers that build from the machine-readable block cannot implement the documented focus behavior, leading to accessibility and UX drift between generated UI and the written standard.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reconcile mobile minimum text size with label token**

The Do/Don't guidance sets a minimum of `16px` text on mobile, but the machine-readable `typography.label.fontSize` is `14px`. When implementers or generators consume tokens directly for form labels on mobile, this creates an immediate standards conflict and can ship typography that violates the same document’s readability rule.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Specify input border width in tokenized component**

The Inputs section requires a `1px` border, but `components.input` only declares `borderColor` without width/style. Any pipeline that treats the front matter as the implementation contract can render inconsistent or missing borders because the structured definition omits a required visual property stated by the prose spec.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
